heroDescription: We're so glad you're considering joining us! Here's everything you need to know for your first Sunday.
parkingBody: Free parking available in our lot. Handicap accessible spaces near the entrance.
expectDescription: We want you to feel comfortable and welcome from the moment you arrive.

expectCards.title: Worship Style
expectCards.description: We practice blended worship, combining traditional hymns with contemporary Christian music. Our services follow the Anglican liturgy with Scripture readings, prayers, a sermon, and Holy Communion every week.

expectCards.title: Holy Communion
expectCards.description: We celebrate Holy Eucharist (Communion) every Sunday. All baptized Christians who love the Lord are welcome to receive. If you're not ready to receive, you're welcome to come forward for a blessing.

expectCards.title: Dress Code
expectCards.description: Come as you are! Any attire is welcome, from "Sunday best" to jeans and t-shirts to shorts and flip flops. We're just glad you're here.

familyIntro: We love having kids in worship! Here's what we offer for families:

familyItems.title: Sunday School
familyItems.description: 1st to 5th graders are dismissed before the sermon and return for Communion

familyItems.title: Teens
familyItems.description: 6th to 12th graders worship with their families

childSafetyBody: The safety of your children is our top priority. All volunteers who work with children undergo background screening and Safeguarding Our People (SOP) training, our diocese's safeguarding program.
fellowshipBody: After the service, we invite you to stay for refreshments and fellowship. It's a great time to meet people, ask questions, and learn more about the CTK community.
nextStepsTitle: Ready to Take the Next Step?
nextStepsBody: If you're interested in learning more about the Anglican faith or becoming a member, we offer a 9-week Catechism class for new believers and those exploring.
